Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: In step 4, the WebSurfer agent failed to correctly navigate to the IMDb profile page for Alain Resnais. Instead of opening the correct URL (which was visible in the search results as `https://www.imdb.com/name/nm0720297`), the agent's action resulted in loading the profile for a different actor, Michael Wincott (URL `https://www.imdb.com/name/nm0000699/`). This navigation error occurred because the agent attempted to visit the specific IMDb link but the browser ended up on the wrong page, leading to a failure to retrieve the required birthplace information for Alain Resnais from that source. Although subsequent steps involved timeouts, the initial data retrieval failure in step 4 was a direct agent error in executing the navigation instruction.
